biggest_catch: The discount is valid ONLY on the day you are approved, only with immediate approval — if your application needs further processing you get nothing. The 25.49% variable purchase APR means carrying any balance costs far more than the $100 maximum, and applying is a hard credit inquiry.
catches: Savings, not income: the $100 maximum is a discount on planned Macy's spending — never buy extra just to chase it.
Valid only on the day you're approved, and ONLY with immediate approval — applications requiring additional processing are not eligible.

$0 annual fee (official macys.com FAQ), but the purchase APR is 25.49% variable (Prime + 21.99%, per the official Department Stores National Bank disclosure PDF on macys.com) — a carried balance wipes out the discount fast.
Full card application = hard inquiry on your credit report.
Excludes services, Macy's gift cards, and certain licensed departments; additional online exclusions apply and in-store exclusions may vary.
Does not apply to previous purchases or to upgrades from a Macy's Card to a Macy's Amex; employees of Macy's and affiliates are not eligible.
Standard 20%-up-to-$100 offer; Macy's may run promotional discounts with different percentages/limits instead of the standard discount.

steps: Apply for a Macy's Card or Macy's American Express Card and receive immediate approval (delayed applications get no discount).
On the day you are approved, make qualifying merchandise purchases with the newly approved card — plan up to $500 of already-planned spending to reach the full $100 savings.
Confirm exclusions (services, gift cards, certain licensed departments) with a store colleague before checkout if unsure.
Pay the statement balance in full by the due date so the 25.49% APR never applies.
